snippet.title: Moonshot Mission Teaser Trailer #1
snippet.description:
A teaser trailer for the snack-sized space action game Moonshot Mission, OUT NOW.

Find it at moonshotmission.planetjone.com

Follow for updates on Instagram, Twitter & Facebook at @MoonshotMission 

🚀 Get ready for an out-of-this-world adventure! 🌕 In Moonshot Mission, you'll join our Finnco-- Fennona-- uh, Finnish astronaut on a hilarious quest to save a scientist who does not want to be saved!

Dive into 50 snack-sized puzzles filled with humor, wacky challenges, and retro pixel goodness. Stay tuned for the launch of the indie game that's perfect for your mobile device and maybe browser, or other platforms Unity can spit versions out on! 🕹️
